title.zh: v2.0.56 力度真正改变音色：51 个预设全部具备演奏动态，不再只有音量变化
title.en: v2.0.56 Velocity Reaches Timbre on All 51 Presets, Not Just Level

highlights.zh: **51 个预设全部具备演奏动态**：此前 21/51 个预设支持「力度→音色」，其余 30 个（模拟主音、风琴、铜管、贝斯、噪声类等）力度只改变音量——轻弹与重弹的差别只是响度，这是「像是编出来的、不是弹出来的」最典型的破绽。现在每个预设都按乐器特性带有各自的动态深度：击弦类（拨弦、钢琴、颤音琴）最深、拉奏/吹奏类次之、垫子与风琴最浅（持续音没有声学理由随力度大幅变亮）、噪声类过渡音色最轻。
highlights.en: **All 51 presets respond to velocity in timbre**: 21 of 51 had it; the other 30 (analogue leads, organ, brass, basses, noise voices) changed only in level, so a soft note and a hard one differed in loudness alone — the most recognisable "programmed, not played" tell. Each preset now carries a depth matched to its instrument: struck patches (plucked, piano, vibraphone) deepest, bowed/blown next, pads and organ shallowest (a sustained tone has no acoustic reason to brighten sh…

highlights.zh: **实测依据**：出厂 pattern 的力度**本来就**有 12 种取值（50–120，扫描 `src/data/genres/**` 得到），所以这个映射是可听的，不是理论上的。
highlights.en: **Measured basis**: the shipped patterns already use twelve distinct velocity values (50–120, scanned across `src/data/genres/**`), so the mapping is audible rather than theoretical.

highlights.zh: **满力度严格不变**：每个深度项在满力度时都是精确的空操作（因子含 `(velCurve − 1)` 或 `(1 − velCurve)`，在 `velCurve === 1` 时为 0），因此标注不会让任何预设在其最强处变响或变闷。这一点由测试断言，而不是靠算术「应该如此」。
highlights.en: **Strictly unchanged at full velocity**: every depth term is an exact no-op at full velocity (its factor contains `(velCurve − 1)` or `(1 − velCurve)`, which is 0 at `velCurve === 1`), so annotating a preset cannot make it louder or duller at its loudest. That is asserted rather than assumed from the arithmetic.
